limits: Finite synthetic corpus, not proof of catching all production mapping bugs.
Joern provides static paths/conditions; runtime PostgreSQL and HTTP assertions grade behavior independently.
Private oracle, build configuration and tests are outside the model edit boundary.
Staged mode precollects tool evidence and runs verification in the harness; it is not autonomous tool discovery.
These are inference-time practice runs, not model weight training.
